summary: AssetAttribute CSV file is used for importing and exporting asset attributes.

headers.name: description
headers.description: Description of the asset attribute in Markdown format.

headers.name: attributeCategory
headers.description: Category of the attribute. Allowed values: `basic`, `technical`, `business`, `quality`, `security`.

headers.name: dataType
headers.description: Data type of the attribute. Allowed values: `string`, `number`, `date`, `boolean`, `text`, `array`.

headers.name: assignableRoles
headers.description: Roles that can fill this attribute, separated by ';'.
